question: You do not know how long child birth takes? You had told me two days ago!

sources.title: Pushing methods for the second stage of labour | Cochrane

reply.text: I should have said it more clearly. For a second birth, the established first stage is about 5 hours on average and is unlikely to last over 12 hours [1]. The second stage, from full dilation to birth, is more variable; Cochrane says pushing time can range from minutes to over an hour, and the evidence is too limited to give one precise usual length [2].
